description.en: Returns the challenge index stored with CMND_SET_ENCOUNT_INFO and clears it (sets it back to -1). The challenge NPCs of a map (the characters that start a match when talked to) are kept in a table of the script system, by index; the challenge script ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut uses these commands.

The index, or -1 if none is stored.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: After a challenge match (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut)
